name: Scary Escape Free
summary: Jump into the action with Scary Escape Free, the ultimate ghost-hunting where you solve puzzles and outrun scary demons! Check out our latest update with 4-player co-op and massive 10-person lobbies to take on the haunt with your whole squad. Whether you're decoding clues or sprinting away from screams, get ready for an epic mix of scares and high-energy fun! 🧟‍♂️
